text:
**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Reject non-integer --runs values**

When an operator supplies a malformed run count such as `--runs 5x` or `--runs 5.9`, this call uses `parsePositiveInt`, whose `Number.parseInt` silently accepts the prefix and runs the campaign five times instead of rejecting the input. Because the campaign's sample count is part of its evidence contract, accepting a different count than the provided value can produce misleading evidence; validate the complete argument as a positive integer before starting the campaign.
